data.description:
Travel to some of the world's most amazing natural wonders in fully immersive 3D to feel like you're really there! Step into a postcard with BRINK Traveler and visit some of the most breathtaking places on Earth today!

🏞️ Featuring:
•44 incredible spots to see across 28 locations
•Room-scale walkable area in each location (a few meters)
•Virtual guide & assistant to learn about locations
•Travel solo or with friends & family multiplayer
•Collect points of interest
•Shoot photos to share with friends
•Download only the locations you want (~500MB each)
•Free content updates with more locations to come
•Free Home Environment featuring Horseshoe Bend

🗺️ Current Locations: 
Pulpit Rock, Norway | Horseshoe Bend | Aoraki / Mt Cook, New Zealand | Landmannalaugar, Iceland | Arches National Park | Navagio Beach, Greece | The Wave | Lone Pine Peak | Bardenas Reales, Spain | Ulsanbawi, South Korea | Antelope Canyon | Mount Sunday | White Pocket | Cirque de Gavarnie, France | Death Valley | Pena Ezkaurre, Spain | Bryce Canyon | Pilat Dune, France | Red Rock Canyon | Alabama Hills | Mount Whitney | Marseille, France | Goblin Valley | Mount Morrison | Glen Canyon | Crystal Crag | Singing Canyon | Haifoss, Iceland

🌎 BRINK XR is also a proud member of 1% for the Planet. We donate a minimum of 1% of our total annual sales to charities focused on environmental protection to ensure the wonderful places of the world are preserved for future generations.

changelog.change_log:
v1.5.1:
• New spot Cappadocia Turkey added, featuring soaring hot air balloons and an ancient cave dwelling!
• Fix for the Walkie Talkie after brief downtime due to an API change.

v1.5.0:
• New spot Navagio Overlook added, featuring our most dynamic location yet!
• HSB plants & river, Landmannalaugar rainbow improvements.
• 2D Apps compatibility beta.
• Backend overhaul preparing for more frequent location releases.
• AI Travel Guide model update.
• Fixed random multiplayer crash

New Spot
• Navagio Overlook: our most dynamic location yet

Improvements
• HSB plants & river, Landmannalaugar rainbow
• 2D Apps compatibility
• Backend overhaul preparing for more frequent location releases
• AI Travel Guide model update

Fixes
• Random multiplayer crash

v1.4.2 - Hotfix Update

Fixes:
• Fixed the AI Walkie-Talkie from endlessly 'Transmitting...' due to a recent change in OpenAI's API.
• Fixed multiplayer avatars mouths not moving.
• Fixed a potential multiplayer crash that could randomly occur.

---

v1.4.1 - Improvements & Fixes Update!

Improvements:
• 35% render resolution increase on Quest 3 resulting in a much sharper experience all around!
• AI Travel Assistant response latency reduced by more than 80% - nearly instantaneous responses now!
• AI Travel Assistant has improved responses and information quality
• Smoother hand movement while holding and interacting with objects, especially in Smooth movement mode.
• New Korean and Chinese voice recordings for the tutorial and new locations.
• Updated French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Japanese voice recordings for new locations.

Fixes:
• Smooth Turning now correctly pivots around the user's center if they've moved by walking.
• Aoraki's lake ice is now correctly lit in Night Mode.
• Fixed a rare bug that would leave a player stuck after upgrading from v1.3.0 if the Virtual Guide was disabled.

---

v1.4.0 - BRINK Traveler Fall 2023 Update!

New Locations:
This release features eight new spectacular and mostly international locations, along with a full remaster of the crowd favorite The Wave!
• Aoraki (Mt Cook): New Zealand's tallest peak, where snow kisses the azure sky.
• Navagio Beach: Greece's secluded cove, cradling the iconic shipwrecked beauty.
• Peña Ezkaurre: Spain's rugged pinnacle, beckoning hikers with panoramic vistas.
• Landmannalaugar: Iceland's geothermal wonder, painted in rainbow-colored rhyolite.
• Banderas Reales: Spain's windswept highlands, where nature's majesty unfolds.
• Red Rock State Park: California's hidden desert jewel, awash in vibrant earthen hues.
• Marseille: France's sun-soaked port, alive with history and Mediterranean charm.
• The Wave: Remastered with two new spots! Arizona's swirling desert masterpiece.

AI Travel Assistant:
• Your very own AI-powered travel assistant is here! If you've ever wanted to learn even more about the amazing places you visit - just ask! Simply speak into your virtual walkie-talkie to ask your questions, and you travel assistant will respond with relevant contextual information spoken back to you.
• We're introducing this as a beta feature for now as it only supports the English language, but we're eager to expand its capabilities and languages in future updates!

Improvements:
• Quest 3 runs at 90FPS - the first of many Quest 3 optimizations to come!
• Public multiplayer now groups people regardless of location they're currently in, making it much more likely to find others online.
• Newly updated and improved introduction tutorial to be faster and clearer.
• Three locations are now included in the initial download so users can start exploring faster.
• Updated locations with additional plants and dynamic effects like a water shader.
• Photo saving (which was broken by Meta Quest software update 56) has been fixed.

BRINK Traveler Winter 2022 Update!

New Locations:
• This release marks the first batch of diverse and international locations we've been capturing!
• Pulpit Rock in Norway features two breathtaking overlooks of iconic Norwegian cliffs and fjords.
• Ulsanbawi in South Korea features the incredible sunrise majesty of Seoraksan National Park.
• Mount Sunday in New Zealand features one of the most icon filming spots from Lord of the Rings.
• Bryce Canyon in USA features two unique hoodoo-lined canyons of Navajo Stairs and Wall Street.
• Sand Dune Arch in USA fills out the last featured natural arch hidden away in Arches National Park.
• Pilat Dune in France is features a massive ocean-side dune surrounded by forests on all sides.

Social Multiplayer Improvements:
• Cross-Platform Multiplayer - travel with friends and family regardless of the platform on Oculus Quest, Oculus Rift, and SteamVR (currently in beta!)
• Easily find other users while connected to Public Mode by looking for player icons on Postcards.
• Full face tracking is now supported for Quest Pro devices.
• Crouching now works in Multiplayer.

General Improvements:
• New 'sitting' mode option in settings to raise your height slightly to improve comfort for seated users.
• Country markers for each postcard to easier identify where locations are worldwide.
• Many bug fixes and optimizations.

BRINK Traveler Summer Update!

Social Multiplayer:
• A whole Social Multiplayer experience - travel solo, or meet with friends and other explorers from across the world.
• Public mode to randomly encounter other explorers as you travel from place to place.
• Private mode to travel with friends and family as a group.
• Meta Avatars integration - to bring your social presence into the experience.
• Parties & Destinations support - invite and jump into an experience with friends right from your Home Environment.
• This is our initial release of Multiplayer, so please report any issues encountered to contact@brinkxr.com - we'd love to hear your feedback!

New Locations Added:
• Cirque de Gavarnie - a natural amphitheater in the beautiful French Pyrenees Mountains.
• Lone Pine Peak - an Alpine climber’s heaven, with steep snowy peaks and breathtaking views.
• Goblin Valley - an alien landscape covered in thousands of hoodoos nicknamed ‘Goblins’
• Singing Canyon - a wide and deep slot canyon with renowned acoustics.

Asian Localization Added:
• Text & Audio Narration localization for Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Traditional & Simplified).

General Improvements
• Camera selfie-mode when in multiplayer!
• Camera wide-angle toggle.
• Camera activation gestures now easier to trigger.
• Easily access images you've taken in BRINK Traveler through your headset's Files app.
• More 3D POI objects added throughout the experience.
• Redesigned Watch UI with improved controller tracking.
• Tips screens during location loading.
• Texture compression improvements (sharper textures and better download sizes).
• Improved visual effects like airplane trails and shooting stars.
• Audio design improvements.

Misc News:
• We've been busily scanning international locations and look forward to having many more coming soon!
• Please welcome our talented new hires to the BRINK team - Danfung and Aaron!

BRINK Traveler Winter Update!

New Spots Added:
• Corona Arch spot added to Arches location.
• Mesquite Flat Dunes spot added to Death Valley South location.
• Glen Canyon is a brand new location.

Localization Added:
• Full subtitles throughout the experience.
• Text & Audio Narration localization for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish.
• Asian localization will be coming soon for Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Traditional & Simplified).

Locomotion & Experience Settings Expanded locomotion options:
• Terrain-follow is now on by default, so any joystick movement will keep you level with the terrain.
• Smooth, Step, and Snap modes for movement and turning. Step mode is now the default for best comfort.
• Slow, Medium, and Fast speed for movement and turning.
• Head or Hand based forward movement direction.
• Enable or Disable movement acceleration.

Experience options:
• Ability to skip the intro tutorial at any time by pressing in both joysticks for 5 seconds.
• Enable or Disable subtitles.
• Enable or Disable music.
• Enable or Disable walkable boundary overlay.
• Enable or Disable haptic feedback.
• Ability to 'crouch' at any time by pressing in the joystick button.

Improved visual effects:
• Realistic dynamic Sun glare that reacts to objects that pass in front of it.
• Improved Night mode with realistic atmosphere and moon glow.
• Waterfalls animation now reenabled on the Quest 1.
• Very subtle cloud and stars movement.

DLC System improvements:
• An overhauled download system which will enable smaller and more efficient downloads after this release. Those updating from 1.0 will need to re-download previous locations this once to sync with the new system (sorry, but there was no way around it!)
• Points of Interest are now included with location downloads, for easier offline usage.

Bug Fixes:
• Fixed instances where users could get stuck in the tutorial if the app was prematurely exited before completion.
• Fixed instances where the watch would stop working if used within the first 5 seconds of traveling to a new location.

Misc News:
• We're focusing on capturing more diverse / international locations this year!
• Multiplayer is one of our most requested features, and it is our top priority for the next major release!
• We're hiring talented travelers! Visit www.BrinkXR.com/careers for more info!

Initial Release of BRINK Traveler!

Brink's mission is to make the wonders of the World accessible to all through virtual travel experiences - and with your support and a bit of luck, we're only just getting started!

We hope you enjoy seeing these amazing places as much as we enjoyed capturing them.

Thanks for joining us on this journey!
